commits.message:
fix(colour): a dial window widens toward its position's count of tones and leaves its ladder's last colour to the pressed button (candybar-joiners-e5r4.cfm) (#510)

* fix(colour): a dial window widens to its position's count of tones, so every distribution keeps neighbours apart at every depth (candybar-joiners-e5r4.cfm)

A window at a depth widened only until it held two tones. Golden angle
keeps neighbours apart only over three, so a three-tone position whose
depth rounds two tones alike left a golden-angle container with pairs
drawn as one colour at 256 and ansi. The window now widens, through the
one `widen`, rung by rung until it holds as many tones as its position
names, and holds fewer only where the role's ladder has no more drawn
apart. Truecolor windows are unchanged.

The adjacency test holds van der Corput over every window of a position
naming two or more and golden angle over every window of a position
naming three, at every depth, and states the edge: a window short of its
count holds exactly what the role draws. The preview test covers dracula
at 256, whose accent window widens back to three.

* fix(colour): a window leaves its ladder's last colour to the pressed button, so a press keeps a colour at ansi (candybar-joiners-e5r4.cfm)

Widening every window to its position's count at ansi took the slot a
three-slot ladder's pressed button needed, so press seams the sweep
cannot hold rose. A press drawn like its neighbour breaks the rule; a
third closed tone is only look. A window now holds
max(2, min(count, colours the depth draws of the ladder - 1)) tones:
the position's count where the ladder draws at least one colour more,
two at ansi wherever a ladder draws three slots. Still one widening
through `widen`, still a memoised lookup, decided by identity alone.

The window and adjacency tests state that size in their own words, the
pinned turn example returns to catppuccin-frappe's middle row, and policy
3, its acceptance line and the colour memory say why the window leaves
the press a colour.

* fix(colour): a window of three is listed lowest, highest, then between, so a rung widened past the dial's tones stands at an end of the walk (candybar-joiners-e5r4.cfm)

Review of PR #510: a widened rung was appended into the slot van der Corput deals at every other cell, so a deepest row at 256 wore a lightening on half its cells. The window test now states the order, that a ladder of more than two keeps a colour no window tone wears, and each edge of the size rule.

* docs(colour): the walk order keeps a row a rung at a time as the depth draws it, and a dial step moves every cell one rung only where the depth draws every rung apart (candybar-joiners-e5r4.cfm)

* fix(colour): the walk order keeps every tone of a window longer than three (candybar-joiners-e5r4.cfm)
